programme.title: Tanzania Transit
programme.desc: On board a sleeper train crossing Tanzania, the stories of three passengers unfold Rukia is an entrepreneurial woman, on her way to begin a new life Isaya is an old Masai man heading back to the bush with his grandson Peter, a powerful preacher, makes money by letting his followers pay for his services This microcosm offers a glimpse into their lives as each character moves towards an uncertain future in this precarious society

programme.desc: In this episode of Animal Super Senses, we find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground and find out how their senses are tuned to survive What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world, …a busy, complex web of life lies just beneath our feet Fossorial animals are well adapted to life underground They live in burrows, tunnels, and mounds using the earth, or whatever substrate they live in, to build their homes, find their food and friends, and stay safe from enemies

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 郭文池牧師 - 給都市人的福音

programme.title: 何偉強牧師-廿一世紀的屬靈人

programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。奉主的名 帶著權柄與邪靈爭戰。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#183粵
programme.desc: 朋徒弟朱莉亞又再求朋教她下廚，開中菜館的她卻求朋教她煮西餐。朱原來想以西餐配合杭州菜弄出新菜色，朋及朱終設計了一系列新杭州菜。可惜，當朱的父親火爺看過菜單後，竟當眾責罵朱此舉正是侮辱了杭州菜。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#28粵普PG
programme.desc: 郭靖一路北上尋找黃蓉，途中助蒙古兵解決了金人，再次見到拖雷。郭靖隨拖雷回草原拜見大汗，大汗讓郭靖跟隨自己西征。郭靖參悟陣法不得要領，但魯有腳總能在次日給出答案，郭靖察覺異常跟蹤魯有腳，卻遇上了歐陽鋒…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 退休Chill級歎世界粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 林希靈、黃愷怡、余德丞、黃碧蓮、李雯希到來，肥媽炮製「椰青蟹」和「香酥軟殼蟹」招待。炸軟殼蟹為何用啤酒？「蒜蓉牛油帆立貝」暗藏四種味道？「秘製豬仔髀」在電飯煲燜煮三十分鐘完成。李雯希還與肥媽Jam歌。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 兒童於10至15歲的發育高峰期，較易出現特發性脊柱側彎；力學、痛症等原因，也可能引致非結構性脊柱側彎。脊醫細說此症的嚴重後果，建議家長留意子女可有出現高低膊、胛骨突出等徵狀，並帶來治療資訊。輕排球的用球較大且輕，場地較小，相對容易掌握，特別適合長者參與。輕排球有助提升心肺功能、手眼協調等，相關團體代表到臨介紹這運動，同來的兩位老友記亦分享參與得着。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅示範「口水汁牛肉粒」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 俊子透過有獎賀年明信片，得到了一些獎品。見此，小丸子決意核對所有收到的賀年明信片有否中獎。經過一輪核對之後，終於發現有一張是中了獎的。但是，那張中了獎的明信片上，卻寫著一些令小丸子困惑的字句。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 導師子健哥哥在「Artspiration」傳授畫圓形的竅門，並示範由中心點下筆，教大家繪畫摩天輪；隨後，在上下左右各方分別畫出包廂，其間可妙用手指來量度出合適距離，加添直線連接，一座大型摩天輪的雛形就此誕生……就着「我去過最美的地方」主題，有小朋友投稿分享於日本北海道薰衣草田、白川鄉合掌村、富士山旅遊的經歷。Tiffany姐姐訴說亦曾到訪同一個薰衣草田；玲玲姐姐也暢談於韓國油菜花田「打卡」的點滴。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 縱使白之女王的目的是出於善意，是為了守護愛麗絲比亞，但她們一伙襲擊女生的所為，始終讓公主無法接受。大敵當前，不代表要放棄愛麗絲比亞的活動，奈津見狀，繼而提議大家舉行一場演唱會。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.desc: 長沙灣一個400多平方呎兩房，屋主兩姊弟均喜歡較深色設計，設計師如何突出不同風格？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 事主駕車遇七人車突切線險撞，對方司機竟下車手持剪刀喝罵，事件經過如何？市民安排網購貨品送到家門外，卻不翼而飛，從防盜影片發現是遭女子偷走，管理處指該女子是住客，但以保安理由拒絕提供資料。某女士於交友平台結識一名自稱兼職女學生，對方暗示可提供援交服務，遂提出見面，希望以愛感化對方。但「女學生」將電話轉給另一男子，他繼而向女士索取一百萬「保證金」……要改善長期失眠、易醒等問題？藥劑師帶來相關參考資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#25粵
programme.desc: 楊光與楊帆鬧翻，並向唐芯、萬里與嘉冰大吐苦水。原來他不滿楊帆變得愛耍手段，自己亦曾因對方而成為網民笑柄，兄弟嫌隙由來已久。失去廣告商支持後，楊光需另想辦法為貓舍籌款。萬里想到一個既可為貓舍籌募資金、又能打擊楊帆的方法。計劃最終大獲成功，令楊帆吃了悶虧。萬里以為楊帆會以特別招數反擊，詎料……其後，楊帆與楊光的姨母梅貴花充當和事老，勸楊光出席與楊帆的「周年活動」，更透露楊帆落敗背後，原來另有內情……

programme.title: 死有對証#5粵PG
programme.desc: 高俊從閉路電視查知暴龍手下生番、鯊膽曾於案發當晚進出木工場，展開追捕卻被二人逃脫，更撞見追蹤此案的柏宇。柏宇想報道工場命案，被警方壓下來，感氣憤。暴龍親自將生番、鯊膽送到警署自首，但二人只承認曾與死者發生衝突，並沒殺人……重案組高級督察高淑嫻獲線索準備落案起訴生番、鯊膽，卻與林琛判斷的死因不符。林琛、淑嫻本為離婚夫妻，再因公事生磨擦。芷昕和高俊重回工場調查，遇到一位與死者相識的小孩，獲關鍵線索……

programme.title: 百花殺#7粵普PG
programme.desc: 華雍被診斷回到中毒最深時，雙眼已不辨顏色，最多再活五年；他刻意疏遠汐和，汐和得知他情況後卻更堅定要嫁給他。長卿起疑，向當年被他暗中救下的青梔之妹打聽汐和青梔有否交情。汐和墜崖，華雍和長贏焦急趕去尋找…

programme.title: 玄戰直播粵PG

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

澳娛綜合呈獻：十月初五的月光#5粵PG
programme.desc: 君好偷聽展輝與莎嬌對話，見莎嬌婉拒展輝所贈金錢感佩服。冰心發現展輝開給莎嬌的支票，不甘心為家庭所負出的一切，將付諸流水，急謀對策。禮信獲派為世光做專訪，金勝向侍應暢談劈友驚險史，禮信不期然亦說出訪問重要人物的經歷。金勝以為禮信被世光收買，刻意毀掉禮信稿件，及後知道怪錯禮信，尷尬離開。禮信從莎嬌口中得悉金勝之可憐身世，明白他為何憎恨世光。莎嬌拉禮信、金勝往唱卡拉OK，二人惺惺相惜，更與文初三人結義。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#183粵
programme.desc: 朋徒弟朱莉亞又再求朋教她下廚，開中菜館的她卻求朋教她煮西餐。朱原來想以西餐配合杭州菜弄出新菜色，朋及朱終設計了一系列新杭州菜。可惜，當朱的父親火爺看過菜單後，竟當眾責罵朱此舉正是侮辱了杭州菜。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#28粵普PG
programme.desc: 郭靖一路北上尋找黃蓉，途中助蒙古兵解決了金人，再次見到拖雷。郭靖隨拖雷回草原拜見大汗，大汗讓郭靖跟隨自己西征。郭靖參悟陣法不得要領，但魯有腳總能在次日給出答案，郭靖察覺異常跟蹤魯有腳，卻遇上了歐陽鋒…

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 王昭君天生麗質，希望成為皇帝的女人，卻被安排出嫁塞外，她分享與匈奴部落首領的婚後生活。劉邦、項羽兩股勢力對抗秦國，為何劉邦能夠獲勝？陶傑、游清源分析他的成功之道。另外，農夫給大家上一課中國人口工程。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 明太祖命名紫禁城的正門為「午門」，為甚麼皇帝喜歡在家門前殺人？午門除了是斬首勝地外，有否其他餘興節目？被歷史形容為奇醜無比的鍾無艷為何可獨佔大王，使其漠視美人夏迎春？陶傑、游清源話你知醜女亦有出頭天。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 廣袤的澳洲有標誌性景觀和獨特野生動物。悉尼以傳奇海港和象徵全國的歌劇院吸引旅人。墨爾本友善熱鬧，迎來全球旅客。澳洲也有優美荒野，從南太平洋海岸延伸至澳洲阿爾卑斯山脈的光禿峰巒，讓人目不暇給。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 沙特阿拉伯最具代表性的款待文化, 其中咖啡就被視為接待客人最佳的禮物 用銅經過敲打、打磨等多重工序製作而成的阿拉伯咖啡壺 - 達拉對沙特人來說是蘊含悠久歷史和傳統的手工藝品

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 波蘭花卉畫彩繪村,花團錦簇 ,鮮豔奪目, 居民們為何在房子裡外畫上鮮豔的花草圖案？印度東北部的那亞村,每戶人家都有Pattachitra畫家,他們唱著自己創作的敘事歌曲,隨著故事內容展開手繪的卷軸畫。

programme.title: 胡說八道真情假期粵
programme.desc: 澳洲到處遍佈刺激玩意，六位成員前往「錯覺樂園」大玩視覺感官遊戲，在疑幻似真的空間接受膽量挑戰。姊妹們忽然童真爆發，手執工具為可愛企鵝DIY小屋，黃智雯卻越幫越忙，被笑稱為「豬一般“Dus”友」。走進墨爾本市中心，六位女生即被當地街頭塗鴉文化吸引；及後還拿起噴漆發揮藝術天分，更得到「肖像永留牆」的驚喜！胡杏兒和胡蓓蔚離隊「撐枱腳」，登上電車華麗車廂享用高級晚宴，期間不忘論盡「人妻」話題。

programme.title: 兩個小生去Camping粵
programme.desc: 愛車的「雙豪」駕駛越野四驅車跨越崎嶇的道路，過程雖有少許波折，但仍能發揮兄弟合作威力成功登山，兼在車上「搭營」。柏豪化身小小發明家，以紙皮盒及錫紙自製「移動焗爐」，可是不少天才都有缺陷，他竟雞鴨不分！Ben堆砌出「雙豪漢堡」，味道勝過快餐店，還令他想起與婆婆的一件趣事。吃飽過後，他們駁好投影機重溫《使徒行者2》。Ben的天堂哥角色原來背負傷感及大量問題？柏豪拍攝途中突然註冊結婚，背後顧慮甚多！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 惡魔島位於加州三藩市灣內，曾是美國關押重犯的監獄，據說全島面積僅有本港九龍公園的一半大小。谷主汛文詳細介紹惡魔島監獄的歷史資料，以及在囚人士在島上的鐵窗生活。原來他們要從事不同的工作，典獄長的管家亦由囚犯擔任！汛文亦細說島上監獄的制度，曾有一條是要求囚犯保持絕對沉默，凱文聽後不禁自言十分鐘都做不到。1962年，惡魔島發生一宗由智慧型囚犯策劃的逃獄行動，事件轟動全美；汛文引領大家回溯當中的越獄細節。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 濠玩夏水禮粵PG
programme.desc: 濕身比拼繼續展開，先要將裝滿水的「綠帽」笠中隊友的頭部，朱朱疑似犯規令戰局更緊湊；潮凱賽後為表友誼，笑言要交換球衣？猜拳潑水遊戲實為友情考驗，無私婉恩為隊友擋水，慘被潑五次！為了掃光桌上美食，兩隊輪流蒙眼轉轉盤，隨時中伏要食辣包辣餅……轉玩人肉推車爆爆波，六號被水潑到寸步難行，連眼鏡都飛走；阮兒卻甚享受？壓軸恐懼開口中，中獎即從逃生艙高速滑下！幸運兒婉恩獲「暖男」六號提出猜拳機會，能否逃過一劫？

programme.title: 世界養生組織粵

programme.desc: 得閒去飲茶！「飲茶文化」可追溯至香港開埠初期，茶館、茶室、茶居如何演變成茶樓、酒樓？「一盅兩件」這講法又是如何得來？戰後，主打早茶午膳的茶樓，跟專營晚飯筵席的酒家，漸漸合而為一，多層的設計更將基層市民與有錢人劃分，茶錢亦因越「高層」而遞增。節目首集還會概述茶樓員工記帳方法的進化，從「漏洞」多多的點算碟子，發展至點心卡、電腦記錄。百年茶樓的資深員工被稱呼為「茶博士」，更是致力做到「水滾茶靚」的專員？

programme.title: 飲茶粵
programme.desc: 蝦餃可謂每枱茶客必叫點心，原來這款逾百年美點由廣州艇家首創，再經酒樓改良。蝦餃要皮薄餡靚，海蝦拌入冬筍尖、肥肉做餡，講求鮮甜爽彈，以十三摺包成半月形皮才符合傳統標準！傳承舊滋味，同時尋求創新，金魚餃好精緻、花旗參湯蝦餃夠養生。凌晨三時營業的本地懷舊小店，是盈盈昔日通宵溫習後飲早茶的食堂？團隊還走訪粵、港兩地體驗飲茶賞粵曲文化。斟茶有禮儀，家英哥提到茶不能斟太滿，並帶來「叩頭」手勢源於乾隆皇的說法。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 從澳洲引入香港養殖的寶石魚肉質紮實而優質，營養豐富，這一集Gigi姐會為大家示範竹蔗蒸寶石魚，原來用竹蔗墊底來蒸魚是一位大廚向Gigi姐建議的，當中有什麼因由呢？Gigi姐還會分享預先切好蔥絲仍能保持新鮮的妙法。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 萬聖節將至，阿古(古嘉俊)繼續為觀眾送上甜品創作「鬼」主意，期間還請來充滿年輕活力的張景淳到來，合作炮製一款富有節日氣氛的「肉桂藍莓朱古力」。由藍莓製成的朱古力外層，配合加入了多種鮮果的朱古力軟心餡料，口味配搭天衣無縫，紫色搶眼造型還與萬聖節氣氛「襯到絕」。阿古竟然拿出「望遠鏡」協助示範製作，到底這件小法寶與控制甜品質量有何關係？

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 瑪蘿帶大家去可以知道世界真相的地方，誰知目的地竟是炎上達的家。眾人跳進湖中，去到另一個世界，並在那裡遇見玄武、白虎、鳳凰和瑪蘿的弟弟月讀。月讀揭開瑪蘿的真正身分，令眾人感到震驚。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 本集的「My Little Show」舞台，為大家呈獻一場精彩的樂器演奏會。兩位小朋友帶來合拍的小提琴、中提琴二重奏；另有男生以色士風吹出<Fly Me To The Moon，還分享吹紙巾的有趣練氣方法。又來到開心唱兒歌的時間，這回Emily姐姐、皓誼姐姐聯同結他導師，為大家重新演唱「經典童謠」<有隻雀仔跌落水和<打開蚊帳的雙語版本。結他導師於介紹移調夾的作用時，還讓姐姐們挑戰升Key。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 爸爸休息在家。剛巧這天因為下雨，小丸子不想外出，於是希望爸爸在家中一起玩。小丸子和小玉，看了說及妖怪鳥的電視節目後十分害怕。第二天，小玉因為要獨自看家而不安。小丸子知道之後決定去陪伴小玉。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 近年全球掀起抹茶熱潮，在需求急升但供應有限情況下，過去兩年日本抹茶價格升超過兩倍，同一時間，中國亦成為新興的抹茶生產國，令抹茶供應鏈出現變化。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 外隊訪港與大型賽事帶動本港足球熱潮，但盛事過後，本地青訓與職業體系能否將熱情，轉換成本地的發展力量？今集採訪三位處於不同階段的本地球員，由學校青訓學生、港超聯現役主力，到過去輝煌一時的退役球員。年輕人在追求職業足球夢想時，前途抉擇與制度之下，會面對甚麼的考驗呢？

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 中信銀行(國際)Motion$呈獻：試真D唷粵
programme.desc: 台南某旅館即使兩小時收費只約五十港元，但衛生狀況令人嘩然。坤哥進房驚見小強「迎賓」，床上更發現疑似之前住客遺留的毛髮。步近浴室，他吸一口氣已轉身想逃走！振朗首試豬油拌飯，入口瞬間雙眼發光，美儀姐亦吃得一臉滿足。光顧「走鬼」路邊爐端燒，排隊之際竟遇警方到場向店家票控！蹲在街邊品嚐完畢，美儀姐笑言可在家自煮？實測一家網傳「寫好評送甜品」的居酒屋，到底有沒有伏？振朗最終亦獲甜品招待，原因卻與網友大不同？

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：女神配對計劃2粵
programme.desc: 女神心動撳燈不設分組，求愛勇者要獲得至少三燈，或與女神心意相通，即可入圍！體操型男坦言試過一夜情，五位女神可會介意？A0自稱翻版韓星，也曾擁有AI女友，Bob啟動「外父Mode」給予考驗。彼此有共通點或可加分，海外留學、擅長下廚等特質觸動女神！某求愛男卻想藉占卜算命專長贏得青睞？男演員放膽表白，缺愛女神卻指昔日合作不太愉快？小鮮肉稱要讓女神「回春」，一秒辣㷫大家！前度震撼登場，望再續未完的故事……

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 對白「Vivienne有少少肚餓」於網絡流傳十幾年，Bob林盛斌和陳嘉佳(小寶)重返拍攝場地受訪。當回顧激烈擁吻戲份，小寶坦言演出前曾致電主創人王祖藍，皆因這是她的人生初吻！瓣數多的Bob被稱「金牌媒人」，卻直言沒想過開相關公司。在電商界打滾數年的小寶多少出於私心，向他提出務實建議。Bob為事業拼搏時，對家庭總有忽略，其家人拍片對他有所「投訴」？當年李思捷策劃的一場婚宴整蠱，為Bob帶來甚麼得着？

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 「一晚限定」，同唱片公司的谷婭溦和Irene林芊瑩共訴<一生中最愛，原來兩人是首次合唱？溦溦的<愛自己啊是想透過歌曲要大家學懂愛自己；芊瑩<如果你記得則講述從一段不被珍惜的關係中擺脫，兩首新歌被主持形容為「CP作」。入行四年的Jaime張天穎與填詞人傾談後，以一首<28:18來記錄28歲和18歲的自己並作出比較，Jaime有何反省和結論？本集亦會倒數本星期「勁歌金榜」二十位走勢。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 張與辰帶行仔到訪一間肉餅飯專門店，品嚐超厚煎蓮藕梅香鹹魚肉餅飯，並向廚師偷師，學習炮製美味肉餅的秘訣。食評家Agnes推介一間創意料理餐廳，與施焯日細味本灣馬賽魚湯、海膽左口魚鹹魚粉煲仔飯等佳餚，充滿驚喜。美食KOL Arthur則帶何泳芍享用茶皇脆皮雞等精緻淮揚菜，並分享拍攝美食的小貼士。觀塘有餐廳推出超值下午茶優惠，包括份量十足的18元鐵板雞扒餐，更可以優惠價加配意粉及果茶，性價比極高。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 沒關係，是一家人(完)
programme.desc: 【母親宣布「卒婚」引發家庭風暴父親失憶揭露大女兒身世秘密】故事圍繞著一對老年夫婦和他們的三名成年子女展開。母親突然宣佈要「卒婚」，因厭倦與脾氣火爆的父親同居，父親則因委屈一度想輕生，卻失敗導致失憶回到22歲，意外揭露大女兒並非親生的秘密。大女兒恩珠發現丈夫是同性戀，內心崩潰，而二女兒恩熙則陷入了複雜的感情糾葛中，被劈腿後又成了上司的情人。小兒子智宇無意中知曉了家族的深藏秘密。「像外人一樣的家人」間產生誤會，不斷磨合理解的家庭劇。

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 行動電源出發吧
programme.desc: 【不插電的戶外實境節目，重新找回心的連結！！】充滿冒險與成長的戶外實境節目，由侯彥西、陳妤帶領一群新人演員，拋開日常科技，踏上從「心」出發的旅程。山林間的挑戰、露營體驗等，讓成員彼此扶持坦誠交流，重新找回與人相處的真實感動。每一次困難互助，都化作心靈的充電，讓旅行不只是冒險，更是成長與情感的累積，他們成為彼此的「行動電源」，燃亮內心最真摯的力量與溫暖。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭(完)
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 水龍吟
programme.desc: 【羅雲熙尋找弒師真相的亡命追途，改寫江湖的命運！！】十年前，唐儷辭親眼目睹師門覆滅，卻被誣陷成弒師兇手，從天之驕子淪為人人喊打的罪人背負沉冤，只為查清那場血案背後真正的黑手。多年後，他帶著刻入骨血的信念重返江湖。為尋找真相，潛入暗勢力盤踞的「十三樓」，捲入武林與朝野交織的陰謀；與此同時，他結識池雲、鍾春髻等真心相伴之人，也在危機四伏的旅途中重新學會信任與牽掛。

programme.title: 行動電源出發吧
programme.desc: 【不插電的戶外實境節目，重新找回心的連結！！】充滿冒險與成長的戶外實境節目，由侯彥西、陳妤帶領一群新人演員，拋開日常科技，踏上從「心」出發的旅程。山林間的挑戰、露營體驗等，讓成員彼此扶持坦誠交流，重新找回與人相處的真實感動。每一次困難互助，都化作心靈的充電，讓旅行不只是冒險，更是成長與情感的累積，他們成為彼此的「行動電源」，燃亮內心最真摯的力量與溫暖。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 水龍吟
programme.desc: 【羅雲熙尋找弒師真相的亡命追途，改寫江湖的命運！！】十年前，唐儷辭親眼目睹師門覆滅，卻被誣陷成弒師兇手，從天之驕子淪為人人喊打的罪人背負沉冤，只為查清那場血案背後真正的黑手。多年後，他帶著刻入骨血的信念重返江湖。為尋找真相，潛入暗勢力盤踞的「十三樓」，捲入武林與朝野交織的陰謀；與此同時，他結識池雲、鍾春髻等真心相伴之人，也在危機四伏的旅途中重新學會信任與牽掛。

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.desc: 淘氣鼠兄弟全新一季！鼠兄弟莫圖、蘭布、喬圖，和小狗小唐之間吵吵鬧鬧的歡樂故事，再度展開！這次，鼠兄弟們又會想出什麼整人的新點子呢？

programme.title: 淘氣鼠兄弟S3

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 行動電源出發吧(完)
programme.desc: 【不插電的戶外實境節目，重新找回心的連結！！】充滿冒險與成長的戶外實境節目，由侯彥西、陳妤帶領一群新人演員，拋開日常科技，踏上從「心」出發的旅程。山林間的挑戰、露營體驗等，讓成員彼此扶持坦誠交流，重新找回與人相處的真實感動。每一次困難互助，都化作心靈的充電，讓旅行不只是冒險，更是成長與情感的累積，他們成為彼此的「行動電源」，燃亮內心最真摯的力量與溫暖。

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.title: 水龍吟
programme.desc: 【羅雲熙尋找弒師真相的亡命追途，改寫江湖的命運！！】十年前，唐儷辭親眼目睹師門覆滅，卻被誣陷成弒師兇手，從天之驕子淪為人人喊打的罪人背負沉冤，只為查清那場血案背後真正的黑手。多年後，他帶著刻入骨血的信念重返江湖。為尋找真相，潛入暗勢力盤踞的「十三樓」，捲入武林與朝野交織的陰謀；與此同時，他結識池雲、鍾春髻等真心相伴之人，也在危機四伏的旅途中重新學會信任與牽掛。

programme.title: Argo's World
programme.desc: Join Marie and Argo in this exciting STEM edutainment mixed-media series as they venture through Cyberspace and make discoveries about the world through historical figures and notable real-world personalities! Special guests include a founding father of the Internet, a NASA astronaut, a top robotics expert, and clever folks from M.I.T!

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | Terror Tubes Takedown | Episode 7
programme.desc: The Gang dives headfirst into the Fear Zone - and it’s pure chaos. With Nightmare Mode activated and the Fear Bomb ticking, only faith can light the way.

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | The Breath of Courage | Episode 8
programme.desc: With 60 seconds left, the Fear Bomb ticks toward doom. Kungfuda and God's Gang fight with faith and love - will light prevail or fear win?

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | Alien Mayhem! | Episode 1, 2, 3
programme.desc: God’s Gang faces insane challenges - from stopping a mad scientist to battling aliens and saving blue whales.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyson the Tanker refuels Jeremy
programme.desc: Oh no, Jeremy ran out of gas! Troy selects the most perfect truck to refuel him: Tyson the Tanker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Francis the Forklift helps at the construction site
programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyler the Tyke steals candy
programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Sabotaje
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La corriente electrica
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.title: The Uninvited Guest
programme.desc: In this suspense thriller, Felix, an architect, lets a stranger into his home to use his phone. When the man suddenly disappears inside the house, Felix finds himself in in a cat and mouse chase and his house becomes a maze.

programme.title: A Yard of Jackals
programme.desc: During the oppressive Chilean dictatorship, a lonely model maker takes refuge in the apparent peace of his neighborhood. However, his life is upended when mysterious neighbors arrive, unleashing a spiral of horror and violence that will leave deep scars.

programme.title: Irreplaceable
programme.desc: Jean-Pierre Werner, a revered and devoted country doctor, discovers that he is suffering from an inoperable tumor. As a doctor from the city arrives to help him with his practice, Werner is troubled by the thought that he is no longer irreplaceable.

programme.title: All My Friends Hate Me
programme.desc: Pete is cautiously excited about reuniting with his college crew for a birthday weekend. But, one by one, his friends slowly turn against him. Is he being punished, is he paranoid, or is he part of some sick joke?

programme.title: Human Capital
programme.desc: Lake Como, Italy. A cyclist is hit off the road by a jeep in the night before Christmas Eve. What happened that night? How will this accident change the destiny of the rich Bernaschi family and the Rovelli family on the edge of bankruptcy?

programme.title: American Skin
programme.desc: Lincoln Jefferson, an Iraqi War veteran, working as a school janitor tries to mend his relationship with his son after a divorce. When his son is killed by a police officer found innocent without standing trial, he takes matters into his own hands.

programme.title: Shadow of Fire
programme.desc: In the ashes of war, three strangers - a woman forced to sell her body, a starving orphan, and a broken soldier - find fragile solace together. Shadow Of Fire is a raw, haunting tale of loss, survival, and the fleeting warmth of human connection.

programme.title: Mr. K
programme.desc: Mr. K, a traveling magician, finds himself in a Kafkaesque nightmare when he can’t find the exit of the hotel, he has slept in. His attempts to get out only pull him deeper, entangling him further with the hotel and its curious inhabitants.

programme.title: In Other Circumstances: The Promise
programme.desc: How well do you know the girl you love? When a teenager's body is found, her parents insist she's still alive. As another girl vanishes, Detective Jana Winter uncovers a web of friendship, longing and secrets where no one is who they seem.

programme.title: The Cave Of The Yellow Dog
programme.desc: Nansal, a Mongolian nomadic girl finds a puppy and brings it home but her father believes it to be bad luck. But when the dog saves the family’s baby, he finally accepts it. Central to this tale is the belief in the cycle of rebirth between man and dog.

programme.desc: The Go Jetters head to Scotland in search of the Loch Ness Monster, but Grandmaster Glitch plans to catch Nessie first, if only his Grimbler was up to the job.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - The Great Little Railway Show
programme.desc: A little railway show comes to Sodor and a misunderstanding leads to all the small engines on railway turning up at Ulfstead Castle to participate.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Picture Planes
programme.desc: When Sarah and Duck are racing paper planes, they chance upon an exciting discovery.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Hat Fuss
programme.desc: Scarf Lady needs some fresh inspiration and Sarah decides that the Hat Museum is the perfect place to visit.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Pumpkin
programme.desc: Stanley must keep Myrtle's pumpkin safe from Speedy the snail. He builds a series of obstacles and defences to protect it from the tenacious Speedy who tests Stanley's ingenuity.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Carnival
programme.desc: Stanley, Sophie and Benjamin make up a new game, 'Dino-Pirates'. This is such a good game, they use it as inspiration for Stanley's carnival float.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Can Make a Dolphin Noise
programme.desc: Back stroke and doggy paddle, flips, and roly-polys. The animals talk about all the fun stuff when swimming.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S03 - It's Time to Be Nature Detectives
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are off to join Cynthia and the Nature Club at the park looking for animals that are hard to spot. JoJo has packed her Nature Tick Book and her magnifying glass. But where is Panda? And why are some creatures really tricky to find? It's time for a Gran Gran plan to help the Nature Club find all of the creatures on their lists, especially the hard-to-spot woodpecker. Can JoJo also help Gran Gran find her missing scarf with the magnifying glass?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Let’s play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Central Park, New York
programme.desc: Glitch is in New York to see a Broadway show, but can't find anywhere to leave the Grimbler. Then he stumbles on Central Park and decides to build his own car park there. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters drop Kyan off nearby, so he can practice his fantastic gymnastics in the park. Kyan discovers a queue of cars making their way across the grass, with a Grimbot traffic warden directing them towards a huge Grim car park.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Cranberries
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the bouncing and singing Cranberries!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Pear
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the fastest woodwind player - Pear!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Teething Problems
programme.desc: Evil Pea is annoyed by Supertato's winning smile, so she takes all the toothpaste in the supermarket! With no toothpaste, Supertato can't have a winning smile. The Tato Team soon realise that it is Evil Pea who has taken them all. Supertato keeps her distracted by pretending to share his brushing routine, while the others take back the toothpaste. When Evil Pea realises what's happening, there is a tug of war over the last tube, and she gets covered in it!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Tatocar Takeover
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are teaching a nervous Chilli how to drive the Tatocar. Suddenly, the car starts moving back and forth! Evil Pea is using a remote control to send the Tatocar speeding backwards to the other side of the supermarket. The Tato Team must make an epic journey back to the veggie aisle to stop Evil Pea from taking over. When they finally make it back, they dress an egg up as Supertato and put it in the car. Now, it is Captain Chilli's turn to use the remote and distract Evil Pea s

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Didgeridoo
programme.desc: Tinky Winky learns to play the didgeridoo. The Teletubbies do a special didgeridoo Tubby Phone Dance. Tiddlytubby Ping loves the didgeridoo too!

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called “The Venoms”, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the “sick people of Asia” and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber(1977)
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His master's daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: An elite fortune hunter and a reckless young heir team up to search for a legendary pirate treasure. Their quest leads them to a remote monastery, where they must outwit a formidable Shaolin monk. However, when ruthless bandits close in, the unlikely allies must put aside their differences and fight side by side to survive.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous “Twin Swords” in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughter's lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father's arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys f

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man’s matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qin's celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - True Colors
programme.desc: When Raffi joins Amelia's rock band, Birch follows on his heels as the band's manager. Soon she's writing songs that pit her and Raffi against their podmates. Pod 4's true colors are revealed once Birch realizes she's gone too far.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Love Lessons
programme.desc: Liam's role as romance advisor to the boys of Cosmos High gets under Birch's skin. Offended that Liam thinks female behaviour is nothing more than a collection of symbols, Birch watches as Liam misinterprets Sandra's signals and ends up with pie on his face.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Miss President
programme.desc: Birch runs for school president because she wants to see changes to the Art program at Cosmos High. On a whim, Liam gets involved and soon his goofy antics are winning him favours. Before long, it's an all-out game of one-upmanship between the two cousins

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Measures Up
programme.desc: After Olivia teases Ian for being too short for a ride, Father mentions that someday Ian may be the taller sibling. Olivia employs a variety of comical methods to stop Ian from growing. She eventually comes to terms with her own height – with the help of a great pair of shoes!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia And The Old West
programme.desc: The class bullfrog is lose, and Mrs. Hogenmuller leaves Olivia in charge as she goes to track it down. Olivia imagines herself as the sheriff of a Wild West town, keeping order and defending against a stampede of giant bullfrogs. But can shedo it alone, or will she need a little help – from Francine?

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia's Fashion Show
programme.desc: After attending a disappointing fashion show with Grandma, Olivia designs some fabulous clothes and is determined to put on her own show. Unfortunately, her models (Ian, Francine and Julian) prove to be more difficult to work with than she'd anticipated. It's up to Olivia to think fast and make the fashion show work!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Makes A Video
programme.desc: When Father takes an out-of-town business trip, Olivia doesn't want him to miss a thing. She decides to create a video diary, filming her family and classmates' everyday life, which isn't quite as exciting as she'd hoped. So Olivia adds her own touch to the final presentation: a big song and dance finish. Dad is thrilled.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tree Troubles Missing Pieces
programme.desc: When Marcus brings home the class tree sapling for the weekend, the Dew Drops see it starting to wilt and must cheer the sapling up, so Marcus can make sure to plant it for his class. When Athena accidentally breaks Lola's nature sculpture, the Dew Drops must go on a scavenger hunt to replace the missing pieces.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Tanaka's Moving Castle Zenko Don't Go
programme.desc: Mr. Tanaka is moving places all by himself, so Team Zenko step in to assist, and learn the importance of asking people for help. When Sam's skateboard competition falls on the same day as her favourite creator Ken KaBlam's comic book signing, TZG secretly prevents him leaving town before she gets the chance to meet him.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Driven to Distraction To Bee or Not To Bee
programme.desc: When easily-distracted Luis is tasked with getting flowers for his grandmother's birthday party, TZG secretly keeps him on track. When Rodney's honey bees escape from their apiary (artificial beehive), TZG secretly brings them back.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Merry Scary Christmas Time Waits For No Ghost
programme.desc: Merry Scary Christmas It's Christmas and Casper wants to spend the holiday with his human pal, Jimmy. Time Waits for No Ghost When Casper discovers a clock that can stop time, everyone wants to use it for his or her own purpose.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Ghostbust A Move My Fair Harpy
programme.desc: Ghostbust a Move When Jimmy's dad decides to move the family away from Deedstown, Casper and his friends vow to stop Mr. Bradley from selling their house. My Fair Harpy The Winter Chill Dance is coming up and Ra is determined to be king.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Chore Score Dew Drop Swap
programme.desc: On Harper’s first allowance day, the pets accidentally knock Harper’s Piggy Bank over and lose one of her quarters that she was reserving to buy Nicholas an ice cream cone. Now the Dew Drops must scramble to replace it! When the Dew Drops struggle to help their kids with tasks that are outside their usual fairy-bilities, they decide to swap kids for the day, but ultimately learn they’ re exactly where they need to be because they know their families so well!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Full House Gift Express
programme.desc: Nicholas keeps stuffing oversized objects inside Eden’s fairy home. But it creates a BIG problem when Harper’s family wants to visit grandma and the car keys are nowhere to be found! When Harper gets sick, Marcus builds a pulley between their apartments to send Harper treats. But when Qwak, the chipmunk, breaks the pulley, the Dews must step in to keep the treat train running.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Salty and Sweet Cruz Blues

Kelp goes to his Dad for answers, and two seemingly different ingredients form something magical. When Cruz is not his usual upbeat self, Kelp tries various ways to cheer him up before realizing the best way to be a good friend is to just sit with him, and let him feel what he’s feeling.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Pet Sitters Narwhalicorn Day
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop pet-sit Crabby, who acts out until they realize he’s missing home. Kelp feels like he can’t choose between a celebration on land or under the sea. So he attempts to do both... at the same time!

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - Animal House
programme.desc: As an approaching storm threatens Berk, Hiccup must work fast to make peace between the food-providing farm animals and the dragons.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - The Terrible Twos
programme.desc: When Hiccup adopts a baby dragon that appears orphaned, Toothless becomes jealous and the baby dragon’s bereaved mother threatens the village.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - In Dragons We Trust

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - How to Pick Your Dragon

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - Portrait of Hiccup as a Buff Man

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - Dragon Flower

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - Heather Report Part I
programme.desc: Hiccup and the gang befriend a beautiful stranger who has a dangerous secret.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - Heather Report Part I

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - The Ditch Sitch

Realizing that Jelleen should be able to stay in her original home, the crew must stand up against the contractor and force her to see the error of h

A note, its content misconstrued, finally convinces everyone of Raffi's dire predicament.

programme.desc: An attempt to quell Liam's manic energy throws Birch into conflict. Does she continue helping her hyperactive cousin learn to relax or does she pull him into the school's Manga Slam? Will Liam become too relaxed or bring a never-before-seen energy to Cosmos High's stage?

programme.desc: After Birch watches a late night mockumentary on TV about aliens among us, she becomes a big ball of paranoia as she misinterprets her schoolmates' head twitches, hand gestures and overall comportment. programme.desc: New girl in town Felicia shows off her robo-dog but it runs out of control, and TZG must secretly stop the barking bot from wreaking havoc. When Lula starts gathering birthday wishes from folks around town, TZG secretly keeps her surprise party under wraps.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Glitter Guide Piano Panic
programme.desc: When the Dews find out their glitter guide (an older Dew Drop) is coming to visit, they bend over backwards to make a great first impression, but end up forgetting some of their responsiblities in the process. programme.desc: Chef J tells a tale about unicorns sailing in ships on clouds in search of Unicorn Land.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - Twinsanity
programme.desc: Hiccup and the gang struggle to uphold the traditions that keep the peace between Berk and the Beserkers.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - When Lightning Strikes
programme.desc: The Vikings of Berk suspect the dragons may be causing lightning storms in the village.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - What Flies Beneath
programme.desc: Toothless encounters a rival from his past.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Alex And Behemoth
programme.desc: When Alex realizes he’s too small to climb onto his new habitat “stage”, he feels too small for his dreams- until he hears of a big, new roller coaster at Coney Island and figures if he can ride the big coaster, that’ll prove that he’s a BIG deal! But when Alex is too short to be allowed on the ride- and his friends find themselves stuck at the top of it- Alex saves the day when he realizes that there are advantages to being small, and learns that his body is perfect just the way it is.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Model Behavior Pillow Fight Club
programme.desc: Satin and Chenille put on a fashion show to impress the trendsetter of Troll VillagePoppy and Branch start a massive villagewide pillow battle to determine who gets the pillow of destiny.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - The Imposter Frenemy
programme.desc: When there is an imposter in Troll Village, Branch and Poppy embark on a man-hunt as to try to keep the Trolls from realizing that anything is offPoppy discovers that Archer Pastry belongs to a group of evil creatures called the Party Crashers

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - An Uphill Battle
programme.desc: The Dragon Knights make a deal for the Storm Wheel but first must obtain the other Storm Wheel from a mysterious mad scientist. programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Mad Scientist

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Apok-ta-pokalypse Now Part 1
programme.desc: As the Dragon Knights prepare to battle for the weapons and control of Tikal, Mastodon attempts to teach Po how to access storm powers to use in the fight. Blade comes face to face with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - Defiant One
programme.desc: Hiccup and Snotlout struggle to find their way back from Outcast Island.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - Breakneck Bog
programme.desc: Hiccup and the gang journey to haunted Breakneck Bog to find a lost gift for Hiccup.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - Gem of a Different Color
programme.desc: Fishlegs finds a special gem, but a flock of dangerous Changewings want it back.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - We Are Family (Part 1)
programme.desc: Hiccup and Toothless search for other Night Furies.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - We Are Family (Part 2)
programme.desc: Hiccup and Toothless are kidnapped and must escape Outcast Island.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - We Are Family (Part 2)
programme.desc: Hiccup and Toothless are kidnapped and must escape Outcast Island.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Joy Story
programme.desc: When Eep and Dawn find a stranded egg, they eagerly take it in as their new pet, but when they learn the egg is not what it seems, they have to return it before it becomes dangerous.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - The Big Shine
programme.desc: When Grug overhears Thunk accidentally call Phil "Dad", he tries to reconnect with Thunk by taking him to the natural spectacle known as "Big Shine."

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Ball in Cup

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Tales from the Fox's Tails
